- `PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL` to the Python package simple index URL

The local build helper also checks the repository root `.env` and
`packages/.env` if the shell variables are unset.

The React-based `data-market-web-ui`, `data-viewer-web-ui`,
`hosting-web-ui`, and `portal-web-ui` images expect npm registry access during
the image build. Set:

- `NPM_REGISTRY_URL` to the package registry root, for example
  `https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/9921/packages/npm/`
- `NPM_AUTH_TOKEN` to a GitLab npm token, or `CI_JOB_TOKEN` in CI, only if the
  registry requires authentication

The local build helper also checks the repository root `.env` and
`packages/.env` if the shell variables are unset.

If a token is set, it is passed to Docker as a BuildKit secret, not as a build
arg, so it no longer appears in the generated image history.

If you run the Kubernetes runtime Makefile, the script is invoked as part of:

```bash
cd deployment/runtimes/kubernetes
make images-build-push
```

The identity provider configurator image is intentionally separate from the
Keycloak runtime image. The runtime image contains the Keycloak server plus the
custom themes and SPI, while the configurator image executes
`apps/identity_provider/sch_configurator/sch_configuration.py` inside a hook
job against mounted `config_sets` and `config_parts`.
=== .env.example ===
# Local output directories
JPYPI_OUT_DIR="./repo_dump"
JNPM_OUT_DIR="./npm_repo_dump"

# Python dependency installs. pip reads this directly; Docker builds receive it
# as INDEX_URL.
PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/pypi/simple"

# GitLab target registry for Python packages
GITLAB_PYPI_UPLOAD_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/pypi"
GITLAB_PYPI_USERNAME="<gitlab-username-or-token-name>"
GITLAB_PYPI_PASSWORD="<gitlab-token>"

# GitLab target registry for npm packages
NPM_REGISTRY_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/npm/"
NPM_AUTH_TOKEN="<gitlab-token>"
GITLAB_NPM_UPLOAD_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/npm/"
GITLAB_NPM_TOKEN="<gitlab-token>"
